meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 它会安装并初始化 OneCLI 的密钥保管库,把 .env 里的 Anthropic 等密钥迁移进去,然后重新构建并重启服务。之后密钥由网关统一管理,代理和容器不再直接看到原始密钥。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 把 OneCLI 作为破坏性变更引入之后、首次设置 OneCLI 时、或 OneCLI 需要从头配置时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化 OneCLI 并迁移 .env 密钥。
say.note: 会执行预检、安装、迁移并重启服务。

say.text: 检查 OneCLI 是否已就绪,没就绪就重新设置。
say.note: 先预检,再决定保留还是重配。

say.text: 重新配置 OneCLI,改用我的 Claude 订阅。

howto.what_en: Installs and initializes the OneCLI Agent Vault, migrates existing .env credentials (e.g. Anthropic keys) into it, then rebuilds and restarts the service. Credentials are managed by the gateway; agents and containers never see raw keys.
howto.when_en: Triggered after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, on first-time OneCLI setup, or when OneCLI needs to be configured from scratch.

say_en.text: Check if OneCLI is ready; reconfigure if not.
say_en.note: Preflights, then asks keep or reconfigure.

say_en.text: Reconfigure OneCLI using my Claude subscription.
say_en.note: Guides you to run claude setup-token.
